subject: Tranche release and final commit — EMEA + APAC forecast tightener
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nils Bergstrom <nils.bergstrom@skystone.se>, Procurement Team <procurement@skystone.se>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Tranche release and final commit — EMEA + APAC forecast tightener

Team / Nils,

Quick one to tighten the window for the Skystone commit this quarter. Finance needs a firm committed number for EMEA and APAC tranches by end-of-day Wednesday (30 Jun). We're asking for a tranche-level breakdown this time so we can model release/recognition for July and Sep payments.

Action items (please respond inline):
- Marissa: confirm which accounts in the EMEA wave are already paperwork-complete and can be counted as committed.
- Monica: any known holdbacks or approval gates (legal/procurement) that will push revenue into next tranche?
- Nils / Procurement: confirm target sign date per tranche and whether the internal procurement checklist is complete.

Attachments: Skystone_MA_Pricing_Tranches_v3.pdf + a draft spreadsheet (see Drive link).

I'll roll these up and circulate a final commit table to finance. If we can't get firm numbers by COB Wed we'll publish a conservative lock (70% of soft) and mark the rest as probable.

Thanks,
Rishi
--
Rishi Malhotra
Director, EMEA Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Nils Bergstrom <nils.bergstrom@skystone.se>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:14:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Tranche release and final commit — EMEA + APAC forecast tightener

On Mon, Jun 28, 2027 at 08:12, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team / Nils,
>
> Quick one to tighten the window for the Skystone commit this quarter...

Rishi —

Short update from my side:
- EMEA wave: I have three accounts with signed SOWs (London hub, Nordics pilot, DACH PO) that are paperwork-complete. I can move those from "best" to "commit" in the spreadsheet.
- Two mid-large deals (Benelux and Iberia) are still awaiting PO; procurement has returned questions about data residency for the Benelux legal team (see notes).

I'll update the shared spreadsheet by EOD today and put a flag on the Benelux item for Monica to triage legal/procurement blockers.

Attachment: updated rows in EMEA-APAC-Commit-Spreadsheet.xlsx (new tab: MAR_ADJ).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, EMEA Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Nils Bergstrom <nils.bergstrom@skystone.se>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Tranche release and final commit — EMEA + APAC forecast tightener

Couple of updates on holdbacks/approvals:
- Benelux: legal needs the DPA amendment (I pushed the sample DPA to their counsel this morning). If they sign by EOD Tue next week we can keep in the July tranche, otherwise it slides.
- Iberia: finance has a special invoicing requirement (split invoicing) — procurement says they will provide PO 48–72h after contract signature.

Triage plan:
- I'll own Benelux follow-up (legal escalation) and loop in Partner Legal (cc'ed internally).
- Tessa — can you confirm whether the split-invoice workflow is acceptable to our billing team? If not, we need a billing exception request with finance.

Monica
Monica Patel
Regional Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Tranche release and final commit — EMEA + APAC forecast tightener

Monica / team —

Quick FYI: billing confirms split-invoice workflows are supported but require a billing-code mapping step (1–2 business days). We'll need Monica to submit the mapping request; finance will apply the code when the first invoice issues.

I can expedite the mapping if you mark Iberia as soft-commit and confirm expected initial invoice amount.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Billing Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Nils Bergstrom <nils.bergstrom@skystone.se>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@skystone.se>, Emma Liu <emma.liu@zenretail.apac>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 17:45:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Tranche release and final commit — EMEA + APAC forecast tightener

Rishi / team —

Thanks for the roll-up. Confirming our side:
- London hub, Nordics pilot, DACH PO: signing complete — Skystone will authorize the July tranche for those three.
- Benelux: counsel expects to clear the DPA by 08 Jul; if so we confirm inclusion in September tranche (please treat as "probable" for the July modelling).
- Iberia: procurement will issue PO once the split-invoice mapping is published (we expect PO in 72 hours after mapping).

Final ask: please circulate the tranche-level commit table with final flags for Finance (Committed/Probable/Soft) — we will respond with any procurement holdbacks in 24 hours.

Regards,
Nils
Nils Bergstrom
Head of Procurement, Skystone Retail
